goal.objective: Independently review the V14 adaptive orchestration architecture before any public runtime-routing or host-controller API is frozen.

assumptions.statement: An owner-reviewed host inventory supplies calibrated capability tiers.
assumptions.rationale: Core cannot establish volatile model quality from provider names.

assumptions.statement: Core compiles and verifies; host adapters perform and observe native IDE effects.
assumptions.rationale: This preserves the accepted V11 and V12 trust boundary.

assumptions.statement: The first effectful reference adapter targets Windows Codex Desktop.
assumptions.rationale: ADR 0006 limits the first release support boundary to Windows.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The host command, observation, controller, adapter, restore, and escalation boundaries are portable and do not revive the universal scheduler.

evidenceRequirements.description: Preserve the exact host lifecycle and portability review.

evidenceRequirements.description: Preserve the exact product and RunView usability review.

evidenceRequirements.description: Preserve the exact routing and public API architecture review.

evidenceRequirements.description: Preserve the exact security and evidence review.
